summary: Recovered the existing text-to-audio stack without rebuilding it. The current durable family includes a published six-voice Audio Lab surface, active Modelos paragraph TTS, and an active generic long-text backend audio-lab-page-audio-v1 that accepts arbitrary text up to 1800 characters and reuses casa_audio_cache. A static Audio Lab object is materialized in Supabase Storage, and an existing audio-lab-page-v1 cache row proves prior generation. Fresh E2E playback/generation was intentionally not invoked, so present audio quality/latency is not claimed as newly verified.
evidence: Supabase Edge Functions observed ACTIVE: audio-lab-public v3, audio-lab-v2 v1, audio-lab-page-audio-v1 v1, modelos-room-audio-v2 v1, modelos-qwen-tts-v2 v1
Supabase Storage observed public-pages/audio-lab-v5.html (17975 bytes, text/html, object metadata httpStatusCode 200)
Supabase casa_audio_cache observed 1 row with voice_id=audio-lab-page-v1 created 2026-09-14
tests: Repository search found no direct browser speechSynthesis implementation for the recovered current path; workflow guardrails explicitly reject speechSynthesis.
Current Modelos manifest records modelosIII-study-paragraph-v2, sha256 421c04c1cc870034fd4c455bf24ce8fd48273df47d0d5cb08a65d6a1d13a0be9, splitSpeechMaxChars=480 and modelos-room-audio-v2.
Supabase management read verified the relevant Edge Functions are deployed ACTIVE and exposed their current source/version metadata.
Storage SQL verified the static Audio Lab HTML object exists with expected HTML metadata.
Cache SQL verified prior persisted output for audio-lab-page-v1 without triggering a new model generation.
No fresh browser playback or POST generation was run; E2E audio quality/latency remains outside this return's verification ceiling.
